questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some benches are tables.

Some tables are chairs.

Some chairs are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some benches are chairs.

II. Some tables are pencils.

III. Some pencils are chairs.

IV. Some pencils are tables.

options.text: Only conclusions II and IV follow
Only conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given statements:

Statements:

Some benches are tables.

Some tables are chairs.

Some chairs are pencils.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0cac3c8e45908b7585338d9bec29659eb6465f2d1cd125106806f400d8e0106.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some benches are chairs → **Does not follow **→ As some benches are tables and some tables are chairs. So some benches are chairs is possible but not definitely followed.

II. Some tables are pencils → Does not follow ​→ As some tables are chairs and some chairs are pencils. So some tables are pencils is possible but not definitely followed.

III. Some pencils are chairs → **F**ollow ​→ As some chairs are pencils. So some pencils are chairs is definitely followed.

IV. Some pencils are tables → Does not follow ​→ As some tables are chairs and some chairs are pencils. So some pencils are tables is possible but not definitely followed.

So, only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No tyre are white.

II. All grey are white.

**Conclusions:**

I. No white is tyre.

II. No tyre is grey.

III. Some white are not grey.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

I. No white is tyre → **Follow **→ As no tyre are white. So no white is tyre is definitely followed.

II. No tyre is grey → **Follow **→ As no tyre are white and all grey are white. So no tyre is grey is definitely followed.

III. Some white are not grey → **Does not follow **→ As all grey are white. So some white are not grey is not definitely followed.

So, Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

16 : 20 :: 256 : ? :: 49 : 56
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: {sqrt{First Number} } ** : **(First number)² + First number = Second number.**

Let's check them one by one.

1) 16 : 20

⇒ { sqrt{16} } = 4 : (4)² + 4 

⇒ 16 + 4 = 20

And,

2) 49 : 56

⇒ { sqrt{49} } = 7 : (7)2 + 7

⇒ 49 + 7 = 56

Similarly,

3) 256 : ?

⇒ { sqrt{256} } = 16 : (16)2 + 16

⇒ 256 + 16 = 272

Hence, the correct answer is **"272".**

questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. In each pair the number on left side of (-) is related to the number of the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three pairs are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. **Option 1) **15 - 56

⇒ 60 - 4 = 56

**Option 2) **13 - 48

⇒ (13 × 4) - 4 

⇒ 52 - 4 = 48

**Option 3) **11 - 39

⇒ (11 × 4) - 4 

⇒ 44 - 4 = 40 ≠ 39.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
